verdicts.reason: A is basically the original shrunk. Everything is packed into the top two-thirds, leaving about 170px of dead space between 'Ships late June' and the legal text. The headline still ends on the orphan 'Evenings', and the logo is very small. B uses the tall canvas better and its headline wraps without an orphan. However, it moves the orange divider below the body copy, so it no longer separates headline and body. It also sets 'Ships late June' too far from the CTA button, has uneven gaps between blocks, and makes the eyebrow line and logo tiny.
